  Thanks for contributing! Please make sure your PR meets the checklist below.
  The PR title must follow Conventional Commits, e.g. `feat(middleware): ...`
-->

## Summary

<!-- What does this PR do? Why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new user-facing feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `perf` — performance improvement
- [ ] `refactor` — no behaviour change
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `build` / `ci` / `chore`

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test` all pass locally.
- [ ] Tests added / updated for new behaviour.
- [ ] `README.md` / `README.zh-CN.md` / `USAGE.md` updated when public API changes.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or internal URLs added.
- [ ] Contains no breaking change **or** the commit body includes a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer.
